categories.main_business_segments: Great Wall Motor Company Limited primarily engages in the design, research and development, manufacturing, sales, and after-sales services of automobiles and automotive parts. Its product portfolio includes SUVs, sedans, pickup trucks, and MPVs, covering traditional internal combustion engines and new energy vehicles. The company operates five major brands: Haval, WEY, ORA, Great Wall Pickup, and Tank, offering a full range of vehicle categories and powertrains.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced technologies in new energy vehicles, intelligent driving, and smart vehicle architectures. It has developed the Hi4 hybrid technology system, including intelligent four-wheel-drive electric hybrid architectures and off-road super hybrid platforms. Great Wall Motor also invests heavily in electric control, electric drive core components, and hydrogen fuel cell technologies, alongside proprietary intelligent cockpit systems, autonomous driving hardware and software, and smart chassis technologies. Production is carried out in multiple full-process vehicle manufacturing bases in China and overseas, with flexible production lines shared between traditional and new energy vehicles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Great Wall Motor serves a broad customer base including individual consumers and commercial users, with a focus on urban and off-road SUV buyers, pickup truck users, and new energy vehicle customers. Its products cater to diverse user scenarios such as city commuting, outdoor activities, family transportation, and commercial logistics. The company’s markets include domestic Chinese consumers and international customers across over 170 countries, with significant sales growth in ASEAN, GCC, Latin America, and other global regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in China, with major manufacturing and R&D facilities located in Hebei, Tianjin, Chongqing, and other provinces. It has expanded its global footprint with manufacturing bases in Thailand, Brazil, and KD plants in Ecuador and Pakistan. Overseas sales networks exceed 1,000 dealerships, and the company exports vehicles to more than 170 countries and regions worldwide, including Europe, ASEAN, GCC, Latin America, Middle East, Australia, and South Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: Great Wall Motor operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive supply chain, focusing on vehicle design, manufacturing, and sales. The company also engages in upstream activities by developing and producing core automotive components such as electric motors, electric axles, and intelligent driving systems. It maintains a vertically integrated supply chain with in-house R&D and production capabilities for key parts, complemented by partnerships with global suppliers like Bosch and Continental.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include accelerating transformation towards intelligent new energy vehicles, deepening R&D in electric, hybrid, and hydrogen fuel cell technologies, and expanding global market presence under the 'ONE GWM' brand strategy. It focuses on innovation in intelligent driving, smart cockpits, and smart chassis, supported by a comprehensive patent portfolio. R&D investments emphasize user-centric technology applications, digital transformation, and building a global R&D network across Europe, ASEAN, and South America.
categories.revenue_model: Great Wall Motor generates revenue primarily through the sale of vehicles and automotive parts. Revenue streams include sales of traditional internal combustion engine vehicles, new energy vehicles (electric, hybrid, hydrogen), automotive components, and related services. The company also earns income from after-sales services, financing, and licensing of technologies. Government subsidies related to new energy vehicles contribute to non-operating income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Great Wall Motor is positioned as a leading Chinese automotive manufacturer with a strong presence in SUVs, pickup trucks, and new energy vehicles. It holds the largest market share in China’s pickup segment and is a top SUV brand domestically and internationally. The company competes with other major Chinese automakers and global players in the new energy and intelligent vehicle sectors. Its focus on intelligent new energy vehicles and global expansion differentiates it from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Great Wall Motor achieved total operating revenue of approximately RMB 173.2 billion, representing a 26.12% increase year-over-year. The company sold about 1.23 million vehicles, up 15.85%, with new energy vehicle sales doubling to 256,432 units. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 7.02 billion, a 15.06% decrease mainly due to foreign exchange impacts. The company maintains a strong asset base of over RMB 20 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures exceeding RMB 11 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Great Wall Motor emphasizes delivering high-quality, technologically advanced vehicles with a focus on intelligent new energy solutions. Its unique value proposition includes the proprietary Hi4 hybrid technology system, comprehensive intelligent driving and cockpit systems, and a diversified product lineup covering all major vehicle segments. The company’s 'forest ecosystem' strategy integrates new energy, intelligent technologies, and global market expansion to provide customers with safer, more efficient, and versatile mobility solutions. Its strong brand portfolio and continuous innovation underpin its competitive differentiation.
